The review is limited to source_catalog_io.py, resources.py, contracts.py and source_catalog.py; no source, test, catalog-resource, Git, Vault, network or human-gate mutation was performed.

findings.title: Copied execution contexts share the parsed schema Registry
findings.problem: R5 requires the captured resource view's registry to be private to its execution context and explicitly forbids independent contexts from sharing a cached Registry. resources._ResourceView stores a mutable registry field, and contracts._registry writes the parsed Registry tuple into that field. ContextVar copy_context() copies the view object reference, so a copied execution context inherits and returns the same mutable Registry object. This defeats the required context isolation and can share parsed schema objects across concurrent validation contexts.
evidence: resources.py:26-33 defines _ResourceView(material, schema_names, registry=None) and stores it directly in the ContextVar.
contracts.py:186-192 reads/writes view.registry as the active-view cache.
SOURCE-CATALOG-R5-RESOURCE-VIEW.md requires that two independent contexts cannot share a cached registry and that parsed schemas remain private to each registry.

minimal_failing_probe.setup: Enter _retained_resource_view with the exact captured 71-schema material from the WIP source clone, call contracts._registry() in the parent, then call contracts._registry() in contextvars.copy_context().run(...).
minimal_failing_probe.command:
PYTHONPATH=.work/parallel/source-catalog-v1/terminal-1/source/src .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from contextvars import copy_context
from pathlib import Path
from video_paper_wiki.resources import _retained_resource_view
from video_paper_wiki.contracts import _registry
root=Path('.work/parallel/source-catalog-v1/terminal-1/source')
material={}; names=[]
for p in sorted((root/'schemas').glob('*.schema.json')):
    names.append(p.name); material[('schema',p.name)]=p.read_bytes()
material[('taxonomy','v1.json')]=(root/'taxonomy'/'v1.json').read_bytes()
material[('catalog','source-catalog-v1.json')]=(root/'catalog'/'source-catalog-v1.json').read_bytes()
with _retained_resource_view(material, tuple(names)):
    first=_registry()[0]
    second=copy_context().run(lambda: _registry()[0])
    print({'schema_count':len(names), 'same_registry': first is second})
PY

findings.required_fix_and_acceptance: Remove the mutable per-view Registry cache or replace it with a cache whose value is set in a separate ContextVar for each execution context. Add a copy_context() regression that asserts distinct Registry identities and no parsed-schema sharing, while retaining nested-view restoration, exception cleanup and unchanged default lru_cache behavior.

known_non_io_observations.observation: resolve_source_catalog currently bounds exact integer evidence_ordinal to 0..1000000. R1 requires exact integer validation and treats an unknown ordinal, including a large or negative integer, as SOURCE_CATALOG_NOT_FOUND; this is a separate semantic API issue for the coordinator to repair after the IO lease.

Re-run generation/resource races: package .py/schema sibling add/remove, ancestor replacement, fixed taxonomy/profile replacement, exact captured bytes, no CWD fallback and ignored __pycache__ activity.
Add and pass the copied-execution-context Registry isolation regression before any exact-head acceptance; this WIP review does not authorize delivery or CI claims.
